name: Pad Sampler Demos
author: Patchkamer
description: Kits en keygroups die alleen de ingebouwde, gesynthetiseerde demo-samples gebruiken: ze klinken meteen, zonder bestand te laden. / Kits and keygroups that only use the built-in synthesised demo samples: they sound at once, without loading a file. Drum and bass kits from the built-in demo samples (Tech Step, Liquid, Dancefloor, Neurofunk, Jump Up, Jungle and Halftime) and two bass keygroups.
